name: Asad Sial
full_role: Fixtures, Standings and Tournament Data Editor
description: Asad Sial maintains CPL fixture, standings and tournament-structure coverage across the site.
bio: Asad Sial supports the structured tournament desk at CPL Season. His coverage connects the match schedule, team directory, venue list and points table so readers can move through the competition without conflicting details.
Before the tournament starts, the standings remain at zero. Once results arrive, he checks the completed match and table state before publishing an update.
coverage_focus: Fixtures, standings, teams and competition structure
method: Keeps schedule, team and venue references aligned.
Updates standings only after a confirmed result.
Checks that tournament pages link back to the correct team and ground records.
